title: [bundle] Fix the hf index intent-aware drift: docs describe hf index
objective: Fix the hf index intent-aware drift: docs describe hf index --intent-aware as a live command, but live hf silently ignores the unsupported flag and runs normal index. Make unsupported hf index flags fail closed with a clear diagnostic instead of silently doing work, update rusty-idd docs to mark intent-aware indexing as future/proposed rather than live, and prove stale docs are gone plus hf index --intent-aware exits nonzero.
acceptance_criteria: hf index rejects unsupported flags such as --intent-aware with nonzero exit and a clear diagnostic instead of silently running normal index.
Regression coverage proves unsupported hf index flags are side-effect free and fail closed.
Rusty-idd docs no longer present hf index --intent-aware as a live command; they mark intent-aware indexing as proposed/future work.
Live hf index still works without unsupported flags.
test_commands: target/debug/hf help index >/tmp/hf-help-index.out && rg -q "usage: hf index" /tmp/hf-help-index.out
